textRuns.value: The METRIC selector switches the monthly chart between burnt area, number of fires and average fire size: the seasonal shape is not the same depending on what you count. Source: EFFIS perimeters (Copernicus EMS / JRC), aggregated to country and month. The March peak is agricultural stubble and steppe burning in eastern Europe, chiefly Ukraine: a different phenomenon from the Mediterranean summer, never averaged in with it.
